note: Job types and pack roles that may move from DeepSeek to Qwen when that starts them sooner. A fix job keeps the preferred model: its quality on Qwen hasn't been measured. The pack's switchable roles (research-checker, review-verifier, security-verifier) are listed as unmeasured until scripts/eval_research.py and scripts/eval_review.py have run; a role moves to its -standard variant only when measured switch-safe (95% paired-bootstrap lower bound of mean(standard - heavy) >= -5% of the heavy mean), or when marked so by hand in .gtu/switch-safe or GTU_SWITCH_SAFE.
